content.title: About
content.content: Wheat germ oil is extracted from the germ of the wheat kernel, which represents the nutrient center of the grain. It is renowned as one of the richest natural sources of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) and essential fatty acids, widely used in dietary supplements and skincare.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: It takes over 50 tons of wheat to produce just one liter of pure wheat germ oil.
It boasts the highest vitamin E concentration among all botanical oils.
Contains octacosanol, a compound studied for enhancing physical performance.
Widely utilized in anti-aging cosmetic formulations.
Has a deep golden-yellow or amber color and a distinct nutty aroma.

items.title: Exceptional Vitamin E Source
items.content: Provides potent antioxidant protection against lipid oxidation.

items.title: Skin Barrier Support
items.content: Helps hydrate dry skin and supports tissue repair and elasticity.

items.title: Heart Health
items.content: Rich in linoleic acid (omega-6) and plant sterols that support healthy lipid profiles.

items.title: Cellular Defense
items.content: Neutralizes free radicals to support healthy cellular aging.

items.title: Gluten Sensitivity
items.content: May contain trace amounts of gluten; people with celiac disease should exercise caution.

items.title: Perishable Oil
items.content: Prone to oxidation and rancidity if exposed to light, heat, or oxygen.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drizzle over salads or warm dishes just before serving. Do not cook with wheat germ oil as heat destroys vitamin E and essential fats.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a dark glass bottle in the refrigerator after opening to prevent oxidation. Use within 2-3 months.
